latest.title: SpaceX wins FCC approval to deploy 1 million orbital data center satellites
latest.description: SpaceX won approval from the FCC to put 1 million orbital data center satellites into space, a proposal that was opposed by Amazon and other groups.

latest.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Gets FCC Approval to Launch AI Data Centers in Space
latest.description: The FCC authorized SpaceX’s solar-powered Starmind constellation, backing Elon Musk’s plans to move AI computing into orbit and reduce the industry’s dependence on increasingly strained power grids here on Earth.

latest.title: 10-year Treasury yield slides despite sticky inflation data as investors buy bonds for protection
latest.description: Bond yields moved lower Wednesday as investors fled to bonds for protection amid sticky inflation data.

latest.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
latest.description: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.

latest.title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
latest.description: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.

latest.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
latest.description: Crypto sentiment is near rock bottom, but Galaxy sees room for a deeper slide and even longtime crypto bulls are wary of buying amid fears of AI and quantum computing.

latest.title: Kalshi traders say state data center moratoriums are more likely than not
latest.description: After Democrats swept Congress and key governor races, Kalshi traders lowered the odds that at least four states would pause data center build-out this year.

latest.title: Bitcoin falls toward $57K amid US tariff fears, hot PCE data as Nasdaq drops 4%
latest.description: The prospect of higher US tariffs and hotter-than-expected PCE inflation weighed on Bitcoin, crypto and stocks on Wednesday.

latest.title: Nvidia agrees to $290M settlement over crypto mining revenue disclosures
latest.description: The proposed settlement would resolve a shareholder lawsuit dating back to 2018 that alleged Nvidia misled investors about its exposure to the cryptocurrency industry.

latest.title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
latest.description: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.

latest.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
latest.description: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

latest.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
latest.description: Kalshi traders have cut the odds of OpenAI confirming an IPO before June 2027, as AI stocks and related markets have weakened.

latest.title: Bitcoin Falls Further as Inflation, Trump Tariffs and AI Selloff Rattle Markets
latest.description: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 as stronger U.S. growth, accelerating inflation and proposed tariffs coincided with a renewed AI stock selloff and bets on higher interest rates in December and beyond.

latest.title: Even the price of toys is on the rise. How Americans are scaling back holiday plans
latest.description: U.S. consumers face higher food, travel and gift costs in 2026 as inflation and Iran-war energy shocks pressure holiday budgets.

latest.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
latest.description: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.

latest.title: Anthropic's stock has been a clunker post-IPO. Why that matters for the AI trade
latest.description: Shares of Anthropic are trading below their IPO price, creating an overhang on other artificial intelligence names.
